s.note: Pat Sr's crabby snacks for the Eagles game
s.how: Mix 250g crab meat with 125g cream cheese, a spoon of mayonnaise, lemon zest and sliced spring onion. Slice a baguette, spread the mix on each slice and grill until golden at the edges. Serve hot on game day.

s.note: the homemade snacks Pat Sr swears bring the Eagles luck
s.how: Mix 250g beef mince and 250g pork mince with grated parmesan, breadcrumbs and an egg. Roll into small balls and bake at 200C for 15 minutes. Warm tomato sauce with brown sugar until sticky and toss the meatballs through. Serve on toothpicks.

m.how: Freeze a 600g rib eye steak for 30 minutes and shave it thin. Fry sliced onion and green capsicum on a hot plate until soft, add the beef and sear fast. Lay provolone on top to melt and pile into long bread rolls. Go Birds.

w.note: Pat and Tiffany's awkward date at the diner
w.how: Soak 100g wheat bran in 300ml buttermilk for 10 minutes. Stir in 100g brown sugar, an egg, 60ml oil and 100g raisins, then fold in 200g self-raising flour. Bake in a muffin tin at 190C for 20 minutes. Serve warm with butter.

d.note: watching the Eagles with Pat Sr
d.how: Chill the lager and pint glasses in the fridge. Pour slowly down the side of the tilted glass. Pour ginger beer for anyone not drinking. Raise a glass every time the team scores and keep the remote within reach.
